newsitem.title: USA: Hayes to buy Bosch business.
newsitem.headline: Hayes to buy Bosch business.

text.p: Bosch Braking Systems Corp and Hayes Wheels International Inc said Friday they reached an agreement under which Hayes will buy Bosch's heavy-duty hub-and-drum and medium and heavy-duty steel wheel businesses.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
The steel-wheel business manufactures and markets tubeless steel disc wheels for medium- and heavy-duty trucks and trailers. Manufacturing is done at a Bosch facility in Frankfort, Ohio.
The hub-and-drum business manufactures and markets hub-and-drum assemblies for the heavy-duty truck and trailer market. Manufacturing is done at a Bosch facility in Johnson City, Tennessee.
The two businesses had combined sales in 1996 of about $40 million.
The sale is contingent on receiving the appropriate regulatory approvals.

Bosch Braking Systems Corp is a unit of Robert Bosch Corp, the U.S. subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, based in Stuttgart, Germany. Bosch is a supplier to the automotive industry, as well as a producer of communications systems, industrial equipment and consumer goods such as appliances and power tools.
Hayes designs, engineers and manufactures steel and aluminum wheels and brake drums and rotors for the automotive and commercial highway markets.
